title: the refusal names the numbers that it measured, and the stand of the arrow proves the reduction that it claims
intent: The wave repairs the proof of the track D (the wave D1) for the sixth time: the discriminator of the package of the waves 93 to 96 found two findings that touch it (F37 -- the numbers of the refusal were read one field off, F38 -- the stand of the arrow printed the ends of the arrow in the places of each other and could never fire).  The kernel and the generator are honest; the proof reported the wrong numbers and kept a guard that never ran.  The wave touches no code of the kernel and no file of the generator -- only the file of the check `tests/checks/check-the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code.sh' (1050 -> 1109 lines, 50745 -> 53997 bytes, +67/-8).  (1) **F37 -- the refusal named the wrong numbers**: the line of the kind `absent' is written as `absent\tfrom\tlabel\tto\tdrawn_count\tcells' -- six fields -- and the reader took the fifth field for the number of the cells of the table and the sixth for a spare; the message of the defect therefore said "which carries 31 of the  cells of the table" -- the number of the cells of the table was empty and the count of the drawn cells stood in its place -- and the branch "the generator does not read the table" asked the sixth field to be zero, which is never the case, so the guard of that refusal stood in the file and was never run.  The condition reads the field that holds the count of the drawn cells now, and the message says "which carries $actual of the $extra cells of the table".  (2) **F38 -- the stand of the arrow could not fire**: the function that prints the arrow of the stand wrote the label in the place of the end and the end in the place of the label (`deciding --> stream-end : post_decide' instead of `deciding --> post_decide : stream-end', the file of the repository says the second one), so the count of the arrows with that label was always zero, the condition that asks for more than one was never true, and the block that removes the copy of the arrow -- and the guard that holds it -- were never reached.  The ends of the arrow are printed in the places of the ends now, the reduction has a function of its own, and the reduction is measured: the stand builds a diagram with two copies of the arrow, runs the reduction and holds that the result carries one copy of the arrow less.  (3) **The repair is proved and not only written**: two new stands were added -- one that holds the number of the cells that the diagram carries and one that holds the diagram that carries no cell of the table at all -- and the number of the stands of the comparison is nine (the wave 96 had seven).  (4) **The claim is not amended and not rewritten**: the text, the falsifier, the scope, the requirements and the control of `the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code' are the same, because the repair gives back to the proof what the note (3) of the wave 96 and the section 16.88 of the plan already promised -- the numbers of the refusal.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about a picture of the site: the pictures of the site are the waves D3 and D4.  The price is named and it is four prices.  (a) **The repair does not widen what the check forbids**: the kinds of the defect, the order of the kinds and the words of every refusal are the same; what changes is the number that the refusal names and the reach of the guard of the absent cell.  (b) **The stands are written in the file of the check and not read out of the kernel**: they measure the comparison and not the machine, so a stand that breaks does not say that the machine is broken.  (c) **The claim is not amended**: the id `the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code', the scope, the requirements and the control are the same, and the text of the claim says nothing about the numbers of the refusal; the repair holds the promise that the note (3) of the wave 96 and the section 16.88 of the plan already made.  A claim that is amended for every defect of its own proof is a claim that measures nothing.  (d) **The stand of the reduction measures the reduction of the stand and not the reduction of the generator**: the generator writes the arrow of the cell as the table of the machine names it, and the stand of the wave 96 that compares the diagram of the repository with the diagram of the copy of the kernel remains the proof of the duplicate; the new measurement only holds that the function of the reduction takes one copy of the arrow less, so that the stand of the duplicate has a diagram with one copy of the arrow to compare with.  (e) **The finding F36 was raised by the parent and was withdrawn by the parent**: the failure of the unit test `yeah-context-estimate-is-cjk-aware' in the log of the gate was the bite of the negative control of the claim `unit-tests-pass' and not a defect of the tree; the note of the parent is in the record of the package.
refuted_by: the diagram of the repository is not the file that the generator writes from the current code, or the generator does not read the table of the machine, or the generator does not read the list of the states, or the diagram does not carry every cell and every state of the machine, or an arrow of the diagram carries ends that are not the ends of its cell, or a cell that the table of the machine names twice is called an absent cell, or a cell whose label the diagram carries nowhere is named a cell that is led elsewhere, or a cell whose label the diagram carries on the ends of the arrows of the other cells is named an absent cell, or the pipeline does not draw the machine in both themes, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when the machine cannot be generated, or the pipeline draws a picture when the generation of the machine failed, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The wave repaired the proof of the diagram of the state machine and touched no code of the kernel and no file of the generator: the two findings of the discriminator of the package of the waves 93 to 96 touched the subject of the refusals of the proof and the reach of its guards.  (1) **The refusal names the numbers that it measured (F37)**: the line of the kind `absent' carries the number of the cells that the diagram draws and the number of the cells of the table, and the message says "which carries 30 of the 31 cells of the table"; the branch that says "the generator does not read the table" is reachable now, because the condition reads the field that holds the count of the drawn cells and not the field that holds the number of the cells of the table.  (2) **The stand of the arrow is proved by a measurement (F38)**: the ends of the arrow are printed in the places of the ends, the reduction has a function of its own, and the stand builds a diagram with two copies of the arrow, runs the reduction and holds that the result carries one copy less; a stand that proves the duplicate and cannot measure its own reduction is a stand that can pass for the wrong reason.  (3) **Two new stands hold the two ways of the absent cell**: one where the diagram carries a part of the table ("the number of the cells that the diagram carries") and one where it carries none of it ("the diagram that carries no cell of the table"); the second is the case that the guard of the refusal protects, and it was measured by no stand before.  (4) **The claim is not amended (dated 2026-11-21)**: the id, the text, the falsifier, the scope, the requirements and the control are the same, and the note (3) of the wave 96 and the section 16.88 of the plan promised the numbers of the refusal before this wave repaired them.  (5) **Four controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-21 by the parent alone**: (a) the honest tree -- the code 0; (b) the old rule of the numbers -- the code 1, with the message that does not say "carries 1 of the 2 cells of the table" and does not say "the generator does not read the table"; (c) the old rule of the arrow -- the code 1, with the message that the diagram of the stand carries the arrow 0 times and that the stand of the reduction needs a diagram that carries it twice; (d) the control of the claim -- the code 1.  (6) **The measurement of the wave**: the file of the check is 1109 lines and 53997 bytes (the wave 96 one was 1050 lines and 50745 bytes); the stands of the comparison are nine (the wave 96 one had seven) and the reduction of the arrow has a measurement of its own; the numbers of the machine are not written in the check and are read out of the code.
